// A typed zero-based position within an ordered collection. Value is the raw
// index; -1 means "none" / "not present". Implementors are single-field
// wrappers over Integer (VertexIndex, FaceIndex, ...), so the Value field
// satisfies this surface directly.
interface IIndex
{
    Value(x: Self): Integer;
}
